responsibility: Declares diagnostic_text_output_format, the concrete diagnostic_output_format for GCC’s traditional text diagnostics. It exposes the text backend’s hooks for reporting diagnostics, diagrams, nesting, path printing, location formatting, include-stack tracking, prefix construction, and source-printing policy selection, along with the state it maintains for pretty_printer integration and for switching between immediate and buffered textual output.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the diagnostic-format-text pair: unlike gcc/diagnostic-format-text.cc, which implements the text diagnostics backend, it declares the diagnostic_text_output_format class, its overridable hooks, helper methods, and persistent state for text rendering and buffering.
